descriptionChirho: The town in lower Galilee where Jesus grew up, variously spelled Nazareth (Ναζαρέθ) and Nazara (Ναζαρά) in the NT manuscripts. The two clusters represent orthographic/textual variants of the same toponym, not different locations. All translations confirm identity: Spanish 'Nazaréth/Nazará/Nazaret', Hindi नासरत throughout, Arabic الناصرة in both, Korean 나사렛 uniformly, Swahili 'Nazareth/Nazará'. The split into accusative forms for S72635 vs mixed cases for S72633 is purely inflectional. BDAG treats both spellings under a single entry. This is one place, one sense.
